source: Буквы SLR и порядок концов шва.svg
target: SLR Letters and Seam Endpoint Order.svg

labels.Буквы SLR и порядок концов шва: SLR letters and seam endpoint order
All cycles are traversed clockwise. The new core receives 0=b, 1=a. Output 23 gives a left turn L, 34 a straight continuation S, and 45 a right turn R.

target: Data for Distinguishing SLR Chains.svg

labels.Полный отмеченный граничный вектор декод: The full marked boundary vector can be decoded at every length. Distinguishability by the polynomial and by a single value is checked up to 18 cores; the general statements remain conjectures.
labels.Отмеченное слово и неотмеченный класс гр: A marked word and an unmarked graph class pose different problems
labels.Доказательство для пяти чисел не доказыв: A proof for five numbers does not prove injectivity of one number

target: Two Probabilistic Interpretations of the Response.svg

labels.Два вероятностных прочтения отклика: Two probabilistic interpretations of the response
labels.Совместный закон корней: вероятности исх: Joint root law: outcomes 11,10,01,00 have probabilities k,r-k,s-k,1-r-s+k. For a walk along unit edges, the stopping rate is 1; at degree 2, each of the two moves and stopping has probability 1/3.
labels.Два признака: является ли контакт корнем: Two indicators: is the contact a root?
labels.Kᵢⱼ = вероятность остановки в j: Kᵢⱼ = probability of stopping at j
labels.при старте из i, где i, j ∈ {x, y}: when starting at i, with i, j ∈ {x, y}

target: Two Ends of One SLR Chain.svg

labels.Два конца одной SLR-цепи: Two ends of one SLR chain
labels.Один граф SLS, прочитанный с другого кон: One graph SLS, read from the other end as SSR. Terminal pairs 3,4 and 15,16 have different normalized spectral passports, although the first coordinate P(1)=221771751 is the same.
labels.Все координаты взяты при ξ = −1; переста: All coordinates are evaluated at ξ = −1; swapping B and C is insufficient

target: Two Experiments with a Grounded Chain.svg

labels.Два опыта с заземлённой цепочкой: Two experiments with a grounded chain
labels.В каждой вершине, включая x и y, есть ед: Every vertex, including x and y, has unit conductance to a common ground. The first experiment, with currents (1,0), gives voltages (r,h); the second, with currents (0,1), gives (h,s).
labels.Вспомогательная сеть G*: по резистору к: Auxiliary network G*: one resistor to a common node per vertex
labels.Все рёбра графа также имеют вес 1: All graph edges also have weight 1
labels.Нулевой ток не означает нулевое напряжен: Zero current does not mean zero voltage
labels.Два опыта · четыре показания: r, h, h, s: Two experiments · four readings: r, h, h, s · the common node * is added

target: Two Period Conventions.svg

labels.Для периода LR и двух повторений внутрен: For period LR repeated twice, the internal word LRLR gives six cores. Four runners LRLR from the starting edge give four cores with internal word RL.
labels.Один период LR · два повторения · разные: One period LR · two repetitions · different ends
labels.Синие рёбра - швы; цифры - номера ядер: Blue edges: seams; numbers: core indices

target: Two Combinations in a Seam Difference.svg

labels.Два сочетания в разности швов: Two combinations in a seam difference
Prefix p gives a five-coordinate passport. Matrix Q selects A−ξB+ξE and C−B. The right continuation gives two eta coefficients. Their scalar product is the difference of characteristic polynomials.
labels.Окружение фиксировано · меняется одна бу: Fixed context · one letter changes S ↔ L
labels.Два сочетания достаточны для этой разнос: Two combinations suffice for this difference; the full passport retains five coordinates

target: Two Mixed SLR Differences.svg

labels.Обе суммы начинаются с chi SSS минус chi: Both sums start with chi SSS minus chi SSL minus chi SLS. With ordinary S/L choices the fourth term is SLL; with an additional boundary permutation it is SLR. At xi=-1 the sums are -102487 and 29282.
labels.Три общих члена · два разных завершения: Three shared terms · two different final terms

target: Dynamic Response of the Original Chain.svg

labels.Динамический отклик исходной цепочки: Dynamic response of the original chain
labels.Одинаковые единичные теплоёмкости в верш: Equal unit vertex heat capacities and edge thermal conductances. No new edges or external heat exchange. Exact self-response and cross-response functions are shown for C6; their weighted integrals are 9/20 and 7/40.
labels.Исходный граф · распространение тепла бе: Original graph · heat diffusion without added edges
labels.У x и y по два соседа: x and y each have two neighbors
labels.Обработка записи: умножить на e⁻ᵗ и прои: Process the record: multiply by e⁻ᵗ and integrate
labels.В общем случае четыре интеграла: r, h, h: In general, four integrals: r, h, h, s
labels.Вес e⁻ᵗ применяется к данным; физической: The weight e⁻ᵗ is applied to data; no heat physically leaks to the environment

target: A Bend and the Fourth Rooted Coefficient.svg

labels.Изгиб и четвёртый корневой коэффициент: A bend and the fourth rooted coefficient
labels.У промежуточного ядра концы двух швов им: In an intermediate core, the endpoints of both seams have degree three. Opposite seams S have no extra edge between them. For L or R, there is exactly one such edge; m33 equals N−1+b.
labels.Красные рёбра — швы; синее — добавочное;: Red edges: seams; blue: extra edge; vertex labels: degrees in the chain

target: Eliminating the End Cores.svg

labels.Четыре внутренние вершины крайнего шести: The four internal vertices of an end hexagon are eliminated. At the seam endpoints, the remaining diagonal is d and the off-diagonal entry is w. Two positions of the second seam give different reduced matrices.
labels.После двух исключений: χ = k² det H: After two eliminations: χ = k² det H

target: Root Weights of Four-Edge Forests.svg

labels.Пять типов размеров компонент: 5; 4,2; 3: Five component-size types: 5; 4,2; 3,3; 3,2,2; 2,2,2,2. Their root weights are 5,8,9,12,16. Green marks one example of root choices.
labels.Один выбор корней; изолированные вершины: One choice of roots; isolated vertices omitted

target: Reading SLR Backwards.svg

labels.Полный код SLR имеет четыре ядра и слово: Full code SLR has four cores and operation word LRS. Decoding removes S, then R, then L, reaching the initial state. The final S specifies the terminal marking; the initial S in the full code is a marker.
labels.Код цепочки SLR · слово операций LRS: Chain code SLR · operation word LRS
labels.Восстановлено LRS → удалить конечное S →: Recovered LRS → remove final S → LR → add marker S → SLR

source: Один шов и две спектральные разности.svg
target: One Seam and Two Spectral Differences.svg

labels.Один шов и две спектральные разности: One seam and two spectral differences
labels.SS и SL различаются одним прямым продолж: SS and SL differ by one straight continuation or bend; SLL and SLR differ in the direction of the second bend. The changed seam is red; the others are blue.

target: Equal Terminal Resistance.svg

labels.Исходные цепочки SS и SL из трёх ядер им: The original three-core chains SS and SL have the same resistance at the canonical terminal edge: 169/204. Replace the prefix by its preceding resistance R; the two branches have resistances 1 and 4+R.
labels.Обычный стационарный опыт на выбранном к: An ordinary steady experiment at the chosen terminal edge
labels.В обоих графах доступны только x и y; до: Only x and y are accessible in both graphs; no edges are added
labels.Параллельные ветви дают Rₙ = (4 + Rₙ₋₁): Parallel branches give Rₙ = (4 + Rₙ₋₁) / (5 + Rₙ₋₁)

target: Reflection and Reversal of an SLR Code.svg

labels.Отражение и обращение SLR-кода: Reflection and reversal of an SLR code
labels.Четыре записи одного абстрактного графа:: Four descriptions of one abstract graph: SLS, SRS, SSR, SSL. The horizontal operation is reflection; the vertical operation reverses the chain. Numbers show the chosen core order.

target: Transfer with a Zero Interior Minor.svg

labels.Перенос при нулевом внутреннем миноре: Transfer with a zero interior minor
labels.Путь a-u-b соединяется с путём a-c-d-b в: Path a-u-b joins path a-c-d-b to form C5. Input a,b is not an edge. At xi=2, the old interior minor is zero, but both polynomial passports are defined.
labels.Полиномиальный перенос без деления на E: Polynomial transfer without division by E
labels.Прямые миноры дают тот же результат: Direct minors give the same result

target: A Periodic SLR Runner.svg

labels.Две последовательно присоединённые копии: Two successively attached copies of P6 are combined into one runner with two inputs and two outputs. Transfer over period LR is U_R U_L.
labels.10 вершин, 10 рёбер; пунктир не входит в: 10 vertices, 10 edges; the dashed edge is not in K.
labels.Один составной бегунок добавляет два ядр: One composite runner adds two cores. After m blocks: s(2m) = (U_R U_L)^m s0.

target: A Straight Chain Zigzag and Spiral.svg

labels.Прямая цепочка, зигзаг и спираль: A straight chain, a zigzag, and a spiral
labels.Верхние схемы показывают прямой и череду: The upper diagrams show straight and alternating codes. The lower one shows a spatial arrangement of ten cycles with constant letter L; crossings in projection are not vertices.
labels.Постоянный L: пространственная цепочка и: Constant L: a spatial chain of 10 cores
labels.В каждом ядре одно и то же положение шво: Every core has the same seam positions; shared edges are blue.
labels.Плоскость не фиксирована. Координаты нуж: No plane is fixed. Coordinates serve the drawing, not spectral transfer.
labels.Поворот SLR задаёт локальное соединение;: The SLR turn specifies local joining; the spatial shape is chosen separately.

target: Five Rooted Coordinates.svg

labels.По одному корневому лесу на C6 для каждо: One rooted forest on C6 for each of five conditions. Green vertices are roots; a red ring marks x and a blue ring marks y. Dashed lines show unselected cycle edges. The forest classes overlap.
labels.d · x и y в одном дереве: d · x and y in one tree

target: Reconstruction with Inexact Data.svg

labels.При известном ограничении N<=7 полный ка: With known bound N<=7, the full catalog contains 365 marked states. Rounding the SLR response to 14 decimal places gives a unique candidate. The mean responses of SSSSSS and SLSSSS admit both codes. An unresolved sector in the interval algorithm does not prove ambiguity.
labels.Что означает результат проверки неточных: What a check of inexact data establishes
labels.или знак делителя не установлен: or the divisor sign is unknown
labels.Каждый найденный кандидат проверяется по: Every candidate is checked against the original measurement intervals

target: Rooted Forest Growth in Periodic Chains.svg

labels.Рост корневых лесов периодических цепоче: Rooted forest growth in periodic chains
labels.Точный предел P(1) в степени 1/N: LR 88,: The exact limit of P(1) to the power 1/N: LR 88.047425; LLS 88.200892; SL 88.305091. Displayed values are rounded.

target: Connections between Results in Spectra of Isomers.svg

labels.Связи результатов серии Спектры изомеров: Connections between results in Spectra of Isomers
labels.Конфигурация даёт матроидные и граничные: A configuration gives matroid and boundary data. The boundary passport supports spectral calculation, boundary transfer, and decoding of the marked chain. The full integer vector at ξ=-1 is equivalent to three exact rational entries of the shifted response. Inverse problems from one polynomial or one number remain conjectural for arbitrary length.
labels.Ядра, швы и упорядоченная конечная пара: Cores, seams, and an ordered terminal pair
labels.По χ или P(1) при заданном N: From χ or P(1) with given N
labels.Точное восстановление отмеченной цепочки: Exact recovery of the marked chain
labels.Ориентированное слово и число ядер восст: The oriented word and number of cores are recovered
labels.Доказано для любой длины в принятом клас: Proved for every length in the chosen class
labels.Двусторонняя связь действует на достижим: The two-way connection holds on reachable SLR-chain states
labels.Спектр матрицы периода и спектр конечног: The period-matrix spectrum and finite-graph spectrum are different data

target: Changing the Active Spectral Boundary.svg

labels.Старый фрагмент G соединяется с ядром K: The old fragment G meets core K only at a,b. Its interior is replaced by block S and factor E. Five new minors are computed at output c,d.

target: Coinciding Leading Rooted Coefficients.svg

labels.Пара SSSL и SSLS различается в p8; пара: The pair SSSL and SSLS differs at p8; the pair SLSLL and SLLSR differs at p10. Each pair shares all preceding coefficients.
labels.p1, …, p7 совпадают; первая разность в p: p1, …, p7 coincide; first difference at p8
labels.p1, …, p9 совпадают; первая разность в p: p1, …, p9 coincide; first difference at p10

target: Contact Matching and the SLR Turn.svg

labels.Соответствие контактов и SLR-поворот: Contact matching and the SLR turn
labels.Фиксированный боковой выход при разных с: A fixed side output with different plug-to-socket matchings gives SLL and SLR. Spanning-tree counts coincide; rooted determinants differ.
labels.Одинаковый путь и боковой выход; разные: The same path and side output; different contact identifications.
labels.У обоих графов 4 ядра, 18 вершин, 21 реб: Both graphs have 4 cores, 18 vertices, 21 edges, and τ = 1189.

target: Spectral Memory of Two Hexagons.svg

labels.Два одинаковых графа из двух шестиугольн: Two identical two-hexagon graphs have P(1)=28435 but different marked outputs. Adding a third hexagon gives isomer B with value 2504096 or A with value 2518737.

target: Three SLR Runners.svg

labels.Один путь из пяти рёбер, вилка (1,0), тр: One path of five edges, plug (1,0), and three distinct ordered outputs. The dashed input edge already belongs to the old graph.
labels.Пять рёбер добавляются. Старое ребро ab: Five edges are added. The old edge ab closes the new C6.
labels.Четыре новые вершины на каждом шаге; пор: Four new vertices at each step; contact order is part of the rule.

target: Three Output Seams of a Hexagon.svg

labels.Три выходных шва шестиугольника: Three output seams of a hexagon
labels.Красный вход упорядочен от 0 к 1. Синие: The red input is ordered from 0 to 1. The blue outputs are ordered from 2 to 3, 3 to 4, and 4 to 5. Arrows indicate pair order, not graph orientation.

target: Three Decoding Sectors.svg

labels.Проекция инвариантной области на b/a,c/a: Projection of the invariant region onto b/a,c/a. Thresholds 4/9 separate L: minus plus, S: plus plus, R: plus minus. The lower-left sector is impossible for descendants. The initial state is at the upper-right corner and is checked separately.
labels.Последний переход определяется двумя зна: Two signs determine the last transition
labels.После выбора применить обратную матрицу: After selection, apply the inverse matrix
labels.Пороги точные; размещение точек на рисун: Thresholds are exact; plotted point positions are approximate

target: Three Phases of the LLS Period.svg

labels.Три фазы периода LLS: Three phases of the LLS period
labels.Внутренние слова LLS, LSL, SLL при одном: The internal words LLS, LSL, SLL with one repetition give five cores. LLS and SLL are isomorphic; LSL has a different spectrum. All three period matrices are similar.
labels.Один период · три начала · два класса гр: One period · three starts · two graph classes
labels.LLS и SLL: отражение и обращение сохраня: LLS and SLL: reflection followed by reversal preserves the spectrum
labels.LLS и LSL: Δp6 = −1 при любом числе повт: LLS and LSL: Δp6 = −1 for every number of repetitions m ≥ 1

target: A Distant Bend and Response Accuracy.svg

labels.Удалённый изгиб и точность отклика: A distant bend and response accuracy
labels.Две цепочки из семи ядер: SSSSSS и SLSSS: Two chains of seven cores: SSSSSS and SLSSSS. Measurements are at the right end. A logarithmic plot shows exact response distances for N from 3 to 14 and the proved upper bound.
labels.Один удалённый изгиб · измерения на прав: One distant bend · measurements at the right end
labels.Общий прямой конец всё сильнее скрывает: A common straight end increasingly hides the left part
labels.Точки вычислены рационально; десятичная: Points are computed rationally; the decimal scale is used only in the figure

target: Four Classes of Four Hexagons.svg

labels.Канонические представители SSS, SSL, SLL: Canonical representatives SSS, SSL, SLL, SLR under the order S<L<R. These are four different graph classes, not four descriptions of one graph.

target: Seams and Degree-Three Vertices.svg

labels.В А швы среднего ядра 01 и 34, в Б — 01: In A, the middle core has seams 01 and 34; in B, 01 and 23. The degree-three vertices induce two separate edges and a path, respectively.

target: The Sixth Moment and Adjacent Turns.svg

labels.Шестой момент и соседние повороты: The sixth moment and adjacent turns
labels.SLL и SLR имеют по четыре ядра и два изг: SLL and SLR each have four cores and two bends. SLL has one LL pair; SLR has no adjacent identical turns. The sixth-moment difference is 6.
labels.Одинаковое число изгибов; разное соседст: The same number of bends; different turn adjacencies
